ns2:section.sectionText: Neural Networks Lecture. This semester, this course introduces students to the basics of neural network modeling. It emphasizes the formal characteristics of the main classes of networks and the evaluation of neural networks as models of human perception and cognition. The course requires familiarity with basic mathematics (matrix algebra and calculus are recommended but not required; basic algebra is a must) and computer programming skills. Students also must register for either 593 CB1 or 593 CB2 lab section.
